get.description: 200 when the database answers, 503 (degraded) when it does not.

post.description: Write a new profile version: body data, timezone and goal. Only the fields sent change; null clears an optional field.
Set which source wins for a metric when several report it, best first (e.g. steps: ring, health-connect, app).
Add an Open Food Facts product to the catalog by barcode (from a find_food remote hit); returns the existing food if it is already there.
Create a food by hand (without id; name and per_100 required) or change one (with id; only sent fields change). New nutrients add a version; past intakes keep theirs.
Hide a food from search and new use; history keeps it.
Create a recipe (without id) or add a new version (with id): items, serves and steps.
Hide a recipe from lists and new use; history keeps it.

get.description: Search foods: local catalog first, then Open Food Facts hits to import with import_food.
One food with its current nutrients per 100 g/ml.
One recipe: items, steps, totals and per portion.
All recipes by name with per-portion nutrients.

post.description: Log 1-50 facts about the owner's body and day. Each event has kind, occurred_at (ISO with offset), optional ends_at (required for sleep and activity), payload (shape per kind; see get_schemas or the daily://schema/{kind} resources) and optional links to earlier chains, e.g. a symptom with relation suspected_cause to an intake. An intake lists items (food_id from find_food, grams) or a recipe_id with portions.
Correct a fact: send the current version's id and the new occurred_at/ends_at and/or the whole new payload. The old version stays in history; links survive.
Retract a fact logged by mistake (current version's id). It stops counting everywhere but stays in history.
Relate two chains, e.g. a symptom (from) suspected_cause an intake (to).
Remove a link between two chains.

get.description: Every version of one fact (chain), oldest first, with its links.

post.description: Run one external source's sync now (e.g. gym-bro) and return its status and counts.

get.description: START HERE in every conversation. The owner's day (default today): summary with the four gauges (kcal, protein, carbs, fat vs targets), timeline, latest weight and 14-day trend, symptoms of the last 3 days, sync status and warnings.
One local day: summary with gauges, and its timeline.
Whole days with events, newest first; pass next_cursor for older days.
The profile, today's targets, source preferences and integration status.
JSON Schemas of every command, query and event payload kind.
